updates.description: The Profile Visibility Preference is now a themed ON/OFF switch. Turn it on to prefer visibility limited to authorized members of your organization, or turn it off to disable that preference. This is an account preference only; server-enforced role and organization permissions always take priority.
The Teams workspace now has a native performance overview with operational totals, completion and punctuality rates, workload-aware team scoring, weekly trends and individual team rankings.
Inventory sections now open in their own focused panels, including Items & Assets, Procurement, Stock Control, Locations, Transfers, Requests, Maintenance, Analytics, Forecast and Movement History.
Personnel now opens in a dedicated full-screen workspace with independently scrollable contacts, conversations and profile details.
A dedicated analysis page brings together team comparisons, performance rankings, improvement guidance, history and measurable next steps.
Opening an operation from an operations queue now displays its details inside that queue panel, so you can return to the same list without losing your place.

MECHNAR now supports release announcements and guided feature discovery across the entire workspace. Updates can be announced globally or targeted to the roles and pages that can actually use them, so new capabilities are not hidden in one role or section.

The Supervisor Teams workspace now provides a full-width zone creation area above a full-width assigned-location directory. Select an assigned location, create operational zones, inspect zone details, personnel, linked operations and activity history.
